seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Washington, D.C.
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Washington, D.C. it currently holds 188 public toilets and 226 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: 421 of the 2,260 places mapped in Washington, D.C. are recorded as free of charge.
